descriptions.w3d_actor_command_jump: Handles jump commands and posts completion when the command finishes.
descriptions.w3d_actor_command_finish_flag: Clears pending command flags and posts the actor completion messages.
descriptions.w3d_actor_command_check_progress: Posts a timeout message for stalled commands and updates the saved position.
descriptions.w3d_actor_command_reset_owner: Resets command flags, reads the owner setting, and optionally posts a message.
descriptions.w3d_actor_probe_slope: Optionally returns the probe direction and tests whether its slope is allowed.
descriptions.w3d_actor_post_alliance_value: Posts a positive value using the allied or opposing actor message.
descriptions.w3d_actor_is_same_alliance: Tests whether an entity shares the actor team or alliance.
descriptions.w3d_actor_has_list_entity: Scans the actor dynamic list for the supplied entity.
descriptions.w3d_actor_post_owner_state_ten: Posts a message when the actor owner is a valid entity in state ten.
descriptions.w3d_actor_entity_has_positive_state: Tests whether the actor entity is valid and has a positive active state.
descriptions.w3d_actor_set_fire_mode: Changes the fire mode bit and posts the corresponding fire-control strings.
descriptions.w3d_actor_mode_is_fourteen_to_eighteen: Tests whether the actor mode is between fourteen and eighteen.
descriptions.w3d_actor_apply_motion_segment: Processes a motion segment and clears velocity when its endpoints differ.
